name: Pablo
message: No half congrats .....Full Congratulations!!! that's an amazing accomplishment.  Well deserved Zero Day.  Enjoy Bethesda and the company.  Eres una dura.  So Proud.

name: Melinda
message: In my area of Cumberland County, PA we had 205 roads blocked by trees and power lines.  Saying out of this weather and enjoying a zero day is the better choice. They are pretty good about getting the trail cleared but it may a bit. The storms were nasty. When you do get into my area there are at least a handful of spots you'll be walking along roads. Be safe.
